description: Cross-language test vectors for Scholium file ids. A file id is the CIDv1 (raw codec, sha2-256, base32) over a file's exact bytes: the same id IPFS assigns a raw single-block file, always starting bafkrei. Every implementation must derive digest_hex and cid from bytes_hex alone, and reject every entry of invalid: format means the string does not decode as a CID at all, version/codec/hash mean it decodes but is not a CIDv1 raw sha2-256 id, canonical means it is such a CID but not spelled in canonical lowercase base32 (the exact form compute_file_id returns).

file_id.input: the file's exact bytes; the empty file is valid
file_id.canonical: lowercase RFC 4648 base32 with the b multibase prefix, no padding; any other spelling of the same CID is rejected

vectors.name: empty
vectors.description: the empty file; a manifest may reference zero-byte files

vectors.name: manifest-main-pdf
vectors.description: the minimal PDF stub listed as main.pdf in the manifest-files vector of records.json

vectors.name: manifest-plot-svg
vectors.description: the SVG listed as figures/plot.svg in the manifest-files vector of records.json

vectors.name: bytes-0-to-255
vectors.description: every byte value exactly once, including 0x00 and 0xff

vectors.name: unicode-text
vectors.description: UTF-8 text echoing the paper.version vector title; multi-byte characters must not be re-encoded before hashing

vectors.name: one-kibibyte-chain
vectors.description: 1024 bytes from a sha-256 counter chain (h = sha256(h || counter), counter from 0); larger than one hash block, deterministic without carrying binary fixtures

invalid.name: empty-string
invalid.description: the empty string is not a CID

invalid.name: truncated-tail
invalid.description: a valid file id with one character appended no longer decodes

invalid.name: bad-padding-bits
invalid.description: a bafkrei-shaped string with wrong pad bits; it appeared in early manifests before validators existed

invalid.name: cidv0-dag-pb
invalid.description: a CIDv0 dag-pb sha2-256 id: wrong version and wrong codec

invalid.name: record-id-dag-cbor
invalid.description: a record id (dag-cbor codec): the kinds must not be confused

invalid.name: raw-sha2-512
invalid.description: a CIDv1 raw-codec id with sha2-512 instead of sha2-256

invalid.name: uppercase-base32
invalid.description: the hello vector's CID in uppercase base32: same CID, non-canonical spelling

invalid.name: base58btc
invalid.description: the hello vector's CID with the z base58btc multibase prefix: same CID, non-canonical spelling
